title.narrative: Multitranche Financing Facility (MFF) - Malolos-Clark Railway Project-Tranche 1

description.narrative: The project will support the construction of two sections, totaling 53.1 kilometers (km), of the North-South Commuter Railway (NSCR), a 163 km suburban railway network connecting the regional center of Clark in Central Luzon with Metro Manila and Calamba, Laguna. The Malolos-Clark Railway Project comprises: (i) Malolos-Clark section (51.2 km) from Malolos to Clark and Clark International Airport, and (ii) Blumentritt extension (1.9 km) connecting Solis and Blumentritt stations in Metro Manila District I (City of Manila). Both sections are part of the NSCR and extensions of the Tutuban-Solis-Malolos section financed by the Japan International Cooperation Agency. The NSCR will be completed during 2022-2025 as an integrated 163 km dedicated suburban passenger railway system comprising four sections: (i) Tutuban-Solis-Malolos, (ii) Malolos-Clark-Clark International Airport, (iii) Solis-Blumentritt-Calamba, and (iv) Clark-New Clark City. The project will provide affordable, reliable, and safe public transport; reduce greenhouse gas emissions; and contribute to cutting travel time from Metro Manila to Clark from 2-3 hours (by bus) to less than 1 hour by rail.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3796: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 16 Jul 2025
Progress Toward Outcome: The loan has been declared effective on 26 September 2019. The bidding period for civil works contract packages, CP N-01 to N-05, and CP S-01 have been completed.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jun 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/52083/52083-002-apfs-en_2.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Jan 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/52083/52083-002-rp-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Dec 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/52083/52083-002-smr-en_18.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Output 1. New railway line commissioned.
Bidding for 6 civil works packages (CP N-01, N-02, N-03, N-04, N-05, and S-01) financed under the project has been completed. Contracts for CP N-04 and N-05 were signed on 1 August 2020. CP N-04 contractor commenced civil works on 30 October 2020 while CP N-05 contractor commenced civil works on 28 October 2020. Contracts for CP N-01, N-02, and N-03 were signed on 8 October 2020. Contractors commenced civil works on 7 December 2020.Contract for CP S-01 underwent rebidding. The contract was signed on 13 July 2023. Contractor commenced civil works on 14 November 2023. No further contracts are expected to be financed under output 1.As of March 2025, all 6 civil works contract packages financed under the project are under implementation. The last contract package (CP S-01) for construction of the main line and station in Bluementritt was signed on 13 July 2023. Instruction to commence was issued on 10 November 2023, effective 14 November 2023. Current progress of the civil works of each package achieved at the end of December 2024 (based on the latest progress report [December 2024], submitted to ADB on 13 January 2025 by the Department of Transportation [DOTr]) is 53.60% for CP N-01, 45.30% (CP N-02), 31.40% (CP N-03), 58.70% (CP N-04), 86.70% (CP N-05), and 4.96% (CP S-01). The overall physical progress is at 46.78%, which is equivalent to 99.5% of target under tranche 1 financing. Part of the loan proceeds were used for price adjustment, cost of redesign, variation orders, and COVID19-related expenditures. The Department of Finance in a letter dated 28 Jun 2024 requested ADB's approval for a provisional 3 month loan closing date extension to enable DOTr to finalize and comply with the requirements of NEDA ICC. ADB provided no objection to the provisional extension covering 1 July 2024 to 30 September 2024 period. Based on another extension request from the government, ADB approved on 3 December 2024 the loan's closing date extension to 31 December 2025. ADB on the same date also approved the government's request to extend the MFF's Availability Period from 31 December 2024 to 31 December 2028, and the combination of the originally-envisioned tranches 2 and 3 into a single tranche 2 amounting to $1.45 billion.
Output 2. Institutional capacity strengthened.
In a letter which ADB received on 6 March 2025, the Department of Finance requested ADB's approval to reallocate the $15.0 million allocation for output 2 to output 1. The reallocation is being requested due to the following reasons: (i) construction works under category 0301-Works are ongoing; (ii) the allocation for category 0301- Works has already been depleted; (iii) tranche 2 is currently being processed with projected effectiveness by May 2025; (iv) there are still progress payments amounting to around Php1.72 billion equivalent to around $30.0 million being processed by DOTr for works done by the contractors as of November 2024, and an additional Php8.84 million equivalent to around $153.0 million worth of invoices from the contractors for works done from February 2025 to April 2025. The requested reallocation was discussed between the Government of the Republic of the Philippines and ADB during the Technical Discussions for tranche 2 held on 27 February 2025. Contract award to provide capacity development to DOTr staff under output 2 will be made under the proposed tranche 2ADB approved the government's request to reallocate the $15 million allocated for output 2 to output. ADB sent the amendment to the loan agreement to the Department of Finance on 24 March 2025 for signing. Implementation of the innovative livelihood restoration system for project affected persons using the Graduation approach was supported by TA 9913-PHI which was completed on 30 November 2023. The final consultant's report has been disclosed and accessible through https://www.adb.org/projects/documents/phi-52083-007-tacr. The TA completion report has also been disclosed and accessible through https://www.adb.org/projects/documents/phi-52083-007-tcr will be disclosed in Q3 2024.
